items.title: Nvidia letter of intent to invest up to $100B in OpenAI
items.update: The LOI never became a contract; in March 2026 Huang said a $100B investment is 'probably not in the cards', and Nvidia put $30B of equity into OpenAI instead.

items.title: Nvidia invests $30B in OpenAI's 2026 funding round
items.update: Closed as part of OpenAI's $122B round at an $852B valuation; WSJ reported in July that Nvidia is also in talks to guarantee about $250B of OpenAI data-center financing (no deal yet).

items.title: SoftBank invests $30B more in OpenAI
items.update: Closed in the $122B round. It was funded with a $40B bridge loan and takes SoftBank's total OpenAI investment to about $64.6B (roughly 13%).

items.title: Amazon to invest up to $50B in OpenAI
items.update: $15B went in first. The other $35B depends on conditions such as an OpenAI IPO or an AGI milestone, and Altman has said there will be no IPO in 2026.

items.title: OpenAI signs $38B multi-year AWS cloud deal
items.update: In Feb 2026 it was expanded by another $100B over eight years (separate entry).

items.title: OpenAI expands AWS contract by $100B, including 2GW of Trainium
items.update: OpenAI committed to 2GW of Trainium capacity, and AWS became the exclusive third-party cloud distributor for OpenAI Frontier.

items.title: Microsoft keeps ~27% of OpenAI after restructuring
items.update: Microsoft sat out the 2026 rounds. An April 2026 amendment made its OpenAI IP license non-exclusive and ended Microsoft's revenue-share payments to OpenAI.

items.title: OpenAI commits to buy $250B of Azure cloud services
items.update: Azure is no longer exclusive but stays OpenAI's primary cloud. OpenAI keeps paying Microsoft a capped revenue share through 2030, and it now leases its Norway capacity through Azure.

items.title: OpenAI signs $300B five-year cloud deal with Oracle
items.update: The deal has not been cancelled. In March 2026 the two companies dropped the Abilene expansion, and in September Oracle issued a force-majeure notice on the OpenAI-linked New Mexico campus.

items.title: Oracle buys ~400,000 Nvidia GB200 chips for Stargate Abilene
items.update: The original Abilene campus is going ahead (2 of 8 buildings live by March 2026), but the planned expansion beyond it was dropped.

items.title: OpenAI to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs
items.update: Deployment of the first 1GW of MI450s was due to begin in H2 2026. No public change to the deal was found.

items.amountLabel: warrants for up to 160M AMD shares
items.title: AMD gives OpenAI warrants for up to 160M shares
items.update: The tranches vest as deployments scale from 1GW to 6GW and as AMD hits share-price targets.

items.title: OpenAI and Broadcom to deploy 10GW of custom AI chips
items.update: In September 2026 Broadcom said OpenAI is on track to buy 1.3GW of 'Jalapeno' XPU clusters in 2027 and about 5GW more in 2028.

items.title: Meta agrees to buy up to 6GW of AMD GPUs
items.update: Deployment of the first 1GW was due to start in H2 2026.

items.amountLabel: warrants for up to 160M AMD shares
items.title: AMD gives Meta performance warrants for up to 160M shares
items.update: The first tranche vests when the first 1GW ships, and later tranches vest as Meta buys more.

items.title: Meta commits to millions of Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin GPUs
items.update: This multiyear deal also covers Grace/Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X networking and capacity from Nvidia cloud partners such as CoreWeave.

items.title: Nvidia invests another $2B in CoreWeave
items.update: Nvidia bought the shares at $87.20 and now holds about 10%. On Oct 15 Huang said CoreWeave needs no backstop.

items.title: Nvidia agrees to buy CoreWeave's unsold capacity, $6.3B
items.update: Nvidia must buy any residual unsold capacity through April 2032.

items.title: CoreWeave buys Nvidia GPUs to build out its AI cloud
items.update: CoreWeave raised its 2026 capex guidance to $35–39B for Nvidia-based capacity and took an $8.5B delayed-draw loan to buy GPU servers.

items.title: OpenAI's CoreWeave compute contracts reach up to $22.4B
items.update: No 2026 expansion was found. CoreWeave's total backlog reached $104.2B by June 2026.

items.title: Microsoft to spend ~$10B on CoreWeave capacity
items.update: Microsoft was still one of CoreWeave's biggest customers in August 2026.

items.title: Meta signs new $21B AI cloud deal with CoreWeave
items.update: This runs to December 2032, on top of the $14.2B deal from Sept 2025 (later raised by about $5B).

items.title: Anthropic signs multi-year compute deal with CoreWeave
items.update: CoreWeave's CEO called it a 'multibillion-dollar contract'.

items.title: CoreWeave's debt pile reaches about $51.6B
items.update: On Oct 15 2026 CoreWeave's 5-year CDS hit a record 1,194bp, and its 2031 bond yields were above 15%.

items.title: Microsoft signs $17.4B GPU capacity deal with Nebius
items.update: Microsoft committed about $6.96B in milestone-based upfront payments, and two of nine tranches had been delivered by Feb 2026. The deal runs to Oct 2031.

items.title: Meta commits up to $27B to Nebius over five years
items.update: This expands a $3B deal from Nov 2025, bringing Meta's total Nebius commitments to about $30B.

items.title: Nvidia makes $2B strategic investment in Nebius
Microsoft contracts Nscale for ~200,000 Nvidia GPUs
items.update: Microsoft pulled out of anchoring Nscale's Loughton, UK site after grid power slipped to the 2030s; Nscale says other contracts are unaffected.

items.title: OpenAI to buy Stargate Norway/UK capacity from Nscale
items.update: In April 2026 OpenAI dropped its direct offtake at Narvik and paused Stargate UK. Microsoft took over the capacity, and OpenAI now leases it through Azure.

items.title: Nvidia joins Nscale's $2B Series C at $14.6B valuation
items.update: Aker and 8090 Industries led the round.

items.title: Nvidia buys $5B of Intel stock (~4% stake)
items.update: The deal closed in Dec 2025 at $23.28 a share. The stake was worth about $30B by June 30 2026.

items.title: Google to invest up to $40B in Anthropic
items.update: The $10B upfront counted toward Anthropic's $65B Series H (May 2026, $965B valuation). The remaining $30B depends on milestones.

items.title: Anthropic expands Google Cloud deal for up to 1M TPUs
items.update: Well over 1GW is due online in 2026. Broadcom said Anthropic is deploying 1GW of Ironwood TPUs this year.

items.title: Anthropic signs multi-gigawatt TPU deal with Google and Broadcom
items.update: Google's April investment deal adds 5GW of TPU capacity over five years. Broadcom expects Anthropic to deploy 5GW of TPUs in 2027 and 10GW in 2028.

items.title: Anthropic orders $21B of Google TPU racks from Broadcom
items.update: Broadcom says Anthropic is on track to become its largest XPU customer in 2027 and 2028.

items.title: Google buys TPUs from Broadcom, multi-tens of billions yearly
items.update: Broadcom said it will ship 'multi-tens of billions of dollars of TPUs annually over the next several years' to Google.

items.title: Amazon invests $5B more in Anthropic, up to $20B later
items.update: This adds to the $8B Amazon invested earlier. The $5B counted toward the May 2026 Series H.

items.title: Anthropic commits over $100B to AWS over ten years
items.update: The deal covers up to 5GW of Trainium capacity.

items.title: Microsoft to invest up to $5B in Anthropic
items.update: Microsoft took part in Anthropic's $30B Series G in Feb 2026 (amount not disclosed).

items.title: Nvidia to invest up to $10B in Anthropic
items.update: Nvidia joined the Feb 2026 Series G. Reuters reports it is in talks to put up to $10B more into Anthropic's planned IPO as an anchor investor.

items.title: Anthropic commits $30B to Microsoft Azure compute
Nvidia backs xAI's $20B Series E (xAI now part of SpaceX)
items.update: SpaceX acquired xAI in Feb 2026, turning Nvidia's stake into 122.8M SpaceX shares worth about $21B at June 30.

items.title: SpaceX/xAI orders Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs for Colossus buildout
items.update: The GPUs are funded through a roughly $40B Apollo-led lease and arrive in H1 2027. xAI is now part of SpaceX.

items.title: Apollo-led lenders commit ~$40B GPU lease to SpaceX/xAI
items.update: The commitment is binding and should close by end-2026. BlackRock, GSAM and KKR-advised accounts are anchors.

items.title: SpaceX sells $25B debut bonds, refinancing xAI and X debt
items.update: The bonds drew about $89B of orders and refinanced the $20B bridge loan that had retired $17.5B of X/xAI junk debt.

items.title: SpaceX (incl. xAI) acquires Cursor maker Anysphere for $60B
items.update: The acquisition became effective on Aug 14 2026, and the Cursor team was folded into SpaceX's AI unit.

items.title: OpenAI Startup Fund backs legal AI startup Harvey
items.update: Harvey raised $550M at a $15.6B valuation in Sep 2026, with Lightspeed and Diffusion leading.

items.title: OpenAI Startup Fund leads Anysphere (Cursor) seed round
items.update: SpaceX bought Cursor for $60B in stock, and the deal closed on Aug 14 2026.

items.title: OpenAI Startup Fund co-leads Ambience Healthcare Series B
items.update: The OpenAI Startup Fund was an existing investor in Ambience's $243M Series C in July 2025.

items.title: Nvidia joins Mistral's €1.7B ASML-led Series C
items.update: Mistral raised a €3B Series D at a valuation above €21B, led by Samsung, in Sep 2026. Nvidia's role in that round is unconfirmed.

items.title: Nvidia invests in Figure AI's $39B-valuation Series C
items.update: The Information reported on Oct 7 2026 that Nvidia had discussed investing about $1B more, at roughly $38B pre-money.

items.title: Nvidia becomes TSMC's largest customer at 19% of revenue
items.update: Nvidia's share of TSMC revenue rose from 12% in 2024 to 19% in 2025, overtaking Apple.

items.title: AMD builds MI450 AI GPUs on TSMC's 2nm process
Broadcom relies on TSMC to make its custom AI chips
items.update: Broadcom says TSMC is hitting capacity limits, which has made it a supply-chain bottleneck in 2026.

items.title: Micron supplies HBM4 memory for Nvidia Vera Rubin
items.update: Micron's HBM4 36GB 12H has been in volume shipment since Q1 2026, alongside SOCAMM2 modules for Vera Rubin NVL72.

items.title: Meta sells $25B of bonds to fund AI buildout
items.update: Peak orders were $96B, down from $125B for Meta's $30B deal in Oct 2025.

items.title: Meta sells $30B of bonds on record $125B orders
Blue Owl JV finances Meta's $27B Hyperion data center
items.update: It is described as the largest-ever private credit deal, and the JV is about 80% owned by Blue Owl.

items.title: Microsoft sells ~$25B of bonds, first US deal since 2017
items.update: The 10-tranche deal drew more than $100B of orders and settles on Nov 4.

items.title: Alphabet raises ~$32B in bonds, including a 100-year note
items.update: That was a $20B US deal plus record sterling and Swiss franc sales, including a £1B 100-year bond.

items.title: Amazon sells $25B of bonds for AI buildout
items.update: This followed about $54B of US and European bonds and a $10B Canadian deal earlier in 2026. Amazon says it won't borrow again this year.

items.title: Oracle sells $25B of bonds amid AI debt fears
items.update: The bonds are part of a $45–50B debt-plus-equity plan for 2026. Oracle said it won't issue more bonds this year.

items.title: $16B financing for Oracle's Michigan data center
items.update: PIMCO took about $10B of the $14B bond portion, which Bank of America offered.

items.title: Banks lend SoftBank $40B to fund its OpenAI stake
items.update: The bridge loan is unsecured, matures March 2027, and comes from JPMorgan, Goldman, Mizuho, SMBC and MUFG.

items.title: Meta signs $10B+ six-year Google Cloud deal
items.update: In Feb 2026 Meta added a multibillion-dollar TPU rental deal (separate entry).

items.title: Meta signs multiyear deal to rent Google TPUs
Meta signs ~$20B multi-year cloud deal with Oracle
Nvidia buys $3B of Meta's stock offering
items.update: Nvidia said it will buy $3B of Meta's stock sale, alongside wider work on Meta's Muse AI models and Nvidia hardware.

items.title: Anthropic rents about $45B of compute from Nscale
items.update: Capacity from Nscale's West Virginia campus is due late 2027; a second deal of similar size is reportedly in talks.

items.title: AMD commits up to $5B equity investment in Anthropic
items.update: AMD's investment is conditional on milestones and is expected to be paid out through fiscal 2028.

items.title: Anthropic to deploy up to 2GW of AMD MI450 chips
items.update: The first gigawatt is due to start in the first half of 2027.
